# VectorStock

> VectorStock is a royalty-free vector graphics marketplace offering access to millions of high-quality vector illustrations, but currently experiencing widespread access restrictions due to VPN/proxy detection and IP-based security blocks.

VectorStock provides a comprehensive collection of royalty-free vector graphics across numerous categories including seasonal themes, animals, food, landscapes, and design elements. The site implements automated traffic detection and IP restriction policies to prevent unauthorized access, resulting in access-restricted error pages for users detected using VPNs, proxies, or automated traffic patterns.
